_doc: aid = numeric source entity ID (legacy key): cuwo alpha references or post-alpha additions; null = unrecorded. v records version provenance; an alpha-reserved ID is not proof of alpha availability. h = hostility default: P passive, N neutral, H hostile, V variable (by tribe), F friendly. cat = category. role = combat role. tame = pet-food id or null. ride = per-page rideable (see pet-food.json for conflicts). boss = always boss species. bossable = may spawn boss-ified. lands = landscapes / habitats. v = versions.
